# AirQR

> Open-source air-gapped file transfer through animated QR codes and RaptorQ fountain codes. No cable, internet, Bluetooth, or pairing. MIT license. Author: Lucas Poignard. Inspired by divan/txqr.

AirQR encodes a file into a looping QR-code GIF. A second device scans the screen and rebuilds the original locally. Missing frames are tolerated. Typical throughput ~8 KB/s on iPhone 12 / laptop. Not a Wi-Fi replacement; use it when pairing or a network is unavailable.

## Canonical URLs

- Source: https://github.com/Thunzyy/AirQR

## Stack

Rust (`packages/airqr-core`) → WASM (web) and Flutter FFI (mobile/desktop). Optional Python sync server. Portable single-file HTML via `build/web_singlefile.py`.
